title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to take action.

【Step 1】Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position value.
【Step 2】The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts sending “Insufficient margin” alerts,
You still have options at this point: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
【Step 3】Maintenance margin level: When losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

The Ethereum Foundation’s developer conference, Devcon 8, is set for November 3–6 at the Jio World Centre in Mumbai. The previous edition was in Bangkok; this time it’s coming to India, just around Diwali.

There’s even more happening throughout the week:

translatedData.content:
ETH historical proof API proposal | Price around $2,457 | I’m waiting for confirmation, not chasing the rally

My view is cautiously bullish, but this is not news that “Ethereum has upgraded.” On October 20, a PR for the eth_getProof API specification, #954, appeared in Ethereum’s execution-layer API repository. The same developer subsequently submitted PR #35986 to the Geth repository. Both are still open: the former seeks to standardize how different clients return account and storage proofs, while the latter proposes replacing a vague generic error with a clear 4444 “historical data unavailable” error when a node has pruned the relevant historical state. The Geth code is still awaiting review from a code owner, and the latest official release listed on the releases page remains 1.17.8. Describing the proposal as already deployed, or using it to imply an on-chain fund security incident, would not be supported by the evidence available so far.

Why should traders pay attention? eth_getProof provides wallets, data services, and auditing tools with the materials needed to verify account state. When a node has pruned historical state, “proof unavailable” means something very different from “account does not exist”: the former is a data-availability issue, while the latter affects business decisions. If clients return inconsistent errors or key-value encodings, service providers have to build additional compatibility measures, increasing the risk of incorrect judgments during risk controls, deposit checks, or historical audits. The specification PR includes test cases and acknowledges that different clients fail some of them. This shows that interface consistency still needs work; it does not mean mainnet consensus has forked. In the long run, clear proof semantics can improve infrastructure reliability, but in the short term they do not directly create new ETH buying demand.

News and price should not be forced into a direct cause-and-effect narrative. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,457, with a 24-hour low of $2,370.41, a high of $2,475, and an opening price of $2,405.43. The current price is above the daily open and near the top of the range, but that does not prove the market is pricing in this PR. In Farside’s table of U.S. spot ETH ETF flows, the total net outflow on October 19 was $103.3 million. For October 20, only some funds had reported figures, while many fields were still blank; the positive figure in the current tally should not be treated as the final inflow for the whole market. Keep flows and software proposals under separate observation, and especially avoid using incomplete data to spin a reversal narrative.

If I were trading this myself, I’d take part, but only with a small spot position: an initial position of 8% of my planned capital, with no leverage. I’d wait for a pullback to the $2,430–$2,440 range, followed by a move back above $2,440 that holds for the next hour. If price surges straight through $2,475 without a pullback and confirmation, I’d rather miss the move. I’d take one-third off near the first target of $2,475, then half of the remainder near the second target of $2,520, protecting the rest with a stop that trails the hourly low. I’d set an initial hard stop around $2,365. If price first breaks below the $2,370.41 low, subsequent complete ETF data continues to show broad net outflows, or the specification and implementation PRs are rejected over key compatibility issues, my short-term bullish view is invalidated and I’d close the entire position. A plan that hasn’t been triggered is just a plan, not realized profit.

Sources: ethereum/execution-apis PR #954, ethereum/go-ethereum PR #35986 and official releases page, Farside daily ETH fund table, and live Kraken ETH/USD pricing.

ETH历史证明接口提案｜现价约2457美元｜我等确认不追涨

我的态度是审慎偏多，但这不是“以太坊已经升级”的消息。10月20日，以太坊执行层API仓库出现eth_getProof接口规范PR #954，同一开发者随后在Geth仓库提交PR #35986。两份文件都还是Open：前者尝试统一不同客户端对账户和存储证明的返回方式，后者提议在节点已清理相关历史状态时，用明确的4444“历史不可用”错误取代含糊的通用错误。Geth这份代码还在等待代码负责人评审，版本页最新正式版仍为1.17.8。把提案写成已经部署、或据此暗示链上资金安全事故，都不符合目前证据。

为什么值得交易员看？eth_getProof给钱包、数据服务与审计工具提供验证账户状态的材料。历史状态已经被节点裁剪时，“拿不到证明”与“账户不存在”含义完全不同；前者是数据可用性问题，后者涉及业务判断。如果各客户端报错与键值编码不一致，服务商就要额外做兼容，容易在风控、充值检查或历史审计时误判。规范PR列了测试样例，也坦白不同客户端在若干样例中有失败项；这证明的是接口一致性仍需推进，不是主网共识已经分叉。长期看，清晰的证明语义利于基础设施可靠性，短期却没有直接新增ETH购买量。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose between “isolated margin” and “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】All the balances in your account are used as collateral. The advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
The downside: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's putting all your eggs in one basket,
supporting each other in the basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spill over to other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess the worst-case scenario for a single bad trade

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

title: 82 Crypto Projects Shut Down in 2026 Across DeFi, Infrastructure and Web3 Gaming
subTitle:
Crypto researcher Stacy Muur listed 82 digital-asset projects and protocols said to have shut down in 2026. According to Odaily, the list includes Balancer, Radiant Capital, Neon EVM and Step Finance, spanning DeFi, blockchain infrastructure and Web3 gaming.
Reasons for closures include falling revenue, depleted funding and security incidents. Bitcoin fell below $60,000 earlier this year, after reaching an all-time high of more than $126,000 in October 2025, adding financial pressure on projects.
Ethereum Layer 2 network Blast said there was no “credible path to economic viability” when it announced its shutdown. Step Finance closed after a major treasury vulnerability, while Radiant Capital ended operations after failing to recover from a 2024 exploit.
A DeFiLlama study in August reported that 100 crypto projects had announced closures in 2026, including 40 in the preceding 90 days. The most common reason was product-market mismatch, followed by depleted funding, insufficient revenue and shifts to other products. The projects had raised about $1 billion and generated $250 million in fees; nine had each raised more than $50 million.

【I’m waiting for the $ 2500 level】

How long has ETH been hovering around $ 2400 this time? Seven days? Ten? I’ve lost count.

Am I itching to make a move? Yes. I really am. But that’s exactly how I got burned in 2017—I got in thinking “it’s about to go up,” didn’t get out when I thought “it’s probably time to leave,” and then decided to “just hold on for dear life.” And that was that.

Honestly, the charts are pretty interesting right now. On the daily chart, each high is lower than the last, but the lows haven’t broken to new lows, forming a converging triangle. On the 4-hour chart, the moving averages are tangled up, and volume has clearly thinned out over the past few days—not because nobody’s trading, but because everyone’s waiting. Waiting for what? A signal—a high-volume candlestick to pick a direction.

I’m keeping a close eye on the $ 2500 level. A break above it could ignite short-term bullish sentiment; a drop below $ 2350 would force those who bought the dip to stop out first. I can’t say who’s buying or selling, but I know this kind of grinding market is the easiest way to lose your nerve. When prices are stuck in limbo, that’s when your patience is really tested.

By the way, BlackRock has filed for another Bitcoin ETF. Nothing to do with ETH. Institutions are positioning themselves in BTC, while ETH is temporarily just following it up, not down. Take this kind of news with a grain of salt—don’t treat it as a reason to hold.

So for now, I’m just sitting back and watching. There’s no point getting worked up because the market hasn’t moved yet. If it does, there’ll still be time to act.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How 100U can control 1000U—and what it costs
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U in capital and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling a
1000U position. If the coin’s price rises by 1%, you earn 10% on your capital (relative to your principal); conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note, the loss is calculated based on the total position, including borrowed funds.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you have to wait for a 10% drop to lose everything; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact level also depends on the margin ratio).

Geth proposes a fix for Blob nodes | ETH near $2,450 | I’m waiting for confirmation, not chasing the price

My stance is neutral to cautious: the development proposal is worth watching, but it shouldn’t be presented as positive news that has already gone live today. Binance Square’s trending topics are currently focused mainly on long-term Bitcoin forecasts, ETF flows, and other projects, while the six-hour search rankings show no directly related ETH hot topic. This time, I’m covering only a code event that is genuinely related to ETH, without forcing it to fit a trend.

On October 20, Geth’s official code repository showed PR #35984, which addresses how responsibility is assigned when data related to Blob transactions is supplied by different peers. The proposal explains that Blob proofs enter the pool alongside transactions, and that the proofs and data units may come from different peers. If validation fails, the result alone cannot establish that the peer supplying the data unit acted maliciously. The proposed change would continue to discard combinations that fail validation, but disconnect the peer only if the party that delivered the failing data also supplied the proof. It would also add regression tests covering different arrival orders and verifying that honest peers can still connect. The page is still marked Open; even though the author lists successful test results, that only means the proposal’s tests passed—it does not mean the code has been merged, much less that all mainnet nodes are running it.

Why does this detail matter for ETH? Blob data is related to the scaling transaction pathway. If nodes mistakenly penalize legitimate peers, it can add friction to data propagation and operations; correcting the attribution logic can help strengthen network resilience. This is a directional benefit for infrastructure maintenance, not a change in ETH supply or a promise that fees will fall today. I also checked Geth’s official releases page and have not treated this unmerged PR as a feature in an official release. Markets can trade expectations ahead of time, but when discussing the news, we need to distinguish between “proposed,” “tested,” “merged,” and “released.”

The price action also offers no evidence of a single cause. At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,450.03, with a 24-hour range of $2,370.41–$2,475.00 and a daily open of $2,405.43. ETH is above the daily open and near the top of its range, but that is not enough to say the rise was driven by a node-fix proposal. I’m watching $2,475 as a short-term confirmation level, around $2,405 as a pullback level, and $2,370 as the range low. If the price breaks above $2,475 but quickly falls back below it, or loses $2,370 and fails to rebound, the bullish outlook is invalidated. If the PR is later closed or the proposal changes substantially, the project-related rationale will also need to be updated.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the rally now. I’d only consider a small, conditional spot long. I would enter a test position using about 2% of my total capital only if the price convincingly moves above $2,475, holds on a retest, and volume does not noticeably contract. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,530, then manage the remaining position at the second target of $2,590. The stop would go below the retest low, with risk on the trade capped at 0.3% of my account. If the price falls back below $2,405 after entry and cannot recover, I’d close the position. If it first breaks below $2,370, I’d cancel the plan and stay out of the market. If the conditions aren’t met, there’s no trade—and no profit to review.

Sources: Geth official GitHub PR #35984, Geth official releases page, and Kraken ETH/USD live quote. #ETH
This is my personal market observation only and does not constitute investment advice.

Geth提出Blob节点修复｜ETH在2450美元附近｜我只等确认不追价

我的态度是中性偏谨慎：开发提案值得看，但不能把它包装成今天已经上线的利好。币安广场热榜眼下主要在讨论比特币长期预测、ETF资金和其他项目，六小时搜索榜也没有对应的ETH直接热点；这轮我只写与ETH确实相关的代码事件，不硬蹭标签。

Geth官方代码仓库10月20日出现PR #35984，处理Blob交易相关数据由不同对等节点提供时的责任归属。提案说明，Blob的证明会随交易进入池中，而证明与数据单元可能来自不同节点；若校验失败，单凭结果不能断定提供数据单元的节点作恶。拟议修改是继续丢弃校验失败的组合，但只有失败交付方同时提供证明时才断开其连接，并补充不同到达顺序及诚实节点仍能连接的回归测试。页面仍标为Open；即便作者列出了测试通过情况，也只代表提案测试，不等于代码已合并、更不等于所有主网节点已经运行。

为什么这个细节会影响ETH？Blob数据与扩容交易路径相关，节点若误伤正常对等方，会增加数据传播和运维摩擦；修正归责逻辑有助于网络韧性。这是基础设施维护的方向性意义，不是ETH供应量变化，也不是今日手续费一定下降的承诺。我还核对了Geth正式发布页面，没有把这条尚未合并的PR当成正式版本功能。市场可以提前交易预期，但做内容必须把“提出”“测试”“合并”“发布”分开。

价格也没有给出单因果证据。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2450.03美元，24小时区间2370.41—2475.00美元，日开2405.43美元。ETH高于日开、接近区间上沿，但不能据此说上涨由一个节点修复提案推动。我看2475是短线确认位，2405附近是回踩观察位，2370是区间下沿；如果冲过2475却很快跌回，或失守2370且反抽失败，偏多观察就被推翻。若PR后续被关闭、方案大改，项目层面的理由也必须更新。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追涨，只考虑现货条件式轻仓做多。只有价格有效站上2475美元、回踩守住且成交没有明显萎缩，才以总资金约2%试仓；第一目标2530美元先减半，第二目标2590美元再处理余仓。止损放在回踩低点下方，单笔账户风险不超过0.3%；若入场后重新跌回2405下方且无法收复，直接平仓。若先跌破2370，原计划取消并保持空仓。未触发就没有成交，更没有利润可复盘。

来源：Geth官方GitHub PR #35984、Geth正式版本页面、Kraken ETH/USD即时报价。#ETH

📰 Just as Arkansas’s mining law was blocked, the court has now delayed the case until year-end: Why is the battle over digital infrastructure approvals still going on?

Arkansas wants to restrict foreigners’ ability to mine Bitcoin in the state. The court has said, “Not so fast.” This case could set a new precedent: whether states can regulate cross-border investment in digital industries may depend on the ruling. It could affect both multinational companies looking to build a digital economy and local economies that rely on mining.

Why does this news matter?

The underlying issue is that mining requires a lot of money and electricity. Local governments want to use “locals first” policies to keep investment in their communities, while mining companies want to recruit workers globally at lower cost. Arkansas’s law is meant to change the rules and give local residents priority. The court isn’t ruling on the merits yet; it wants to see how other states handle the issue before deciding. This means policy competition among states is likely to intensify, and rules for cross-border investment in digital industries may become increasingly varied.

Market impact

This news won’t directly move prices, but it signals that regulatory uncertainty in the mining industry remains. Mining companies around the world are already competing over electricity prices and land. The longer the ruling is delayed, the fewer companies will be willing to make major investments. If every state can legislate as it pleases, cross-border mining companies will become more cautious and may shift their capital to places with clearer policies. In the long run, this could put some pressure on BTC demand, since mining is one of the most direct sources of demand for BTC. In the short term, however, the market may see some volatility driven by “policy risk.” There haven’t been many similar cases in the past, but changes in countries’ industrial policies toward foreign investment may offer a useful point of comparison.

Trading outlook

💡 For now, this doesn’t point clearly in either direction for BTC/ETH; it simply raises the risk premium for investment in digital infrastructure. If a state eventually imposes strict restrictions on foreign mining, BTC’s demand side could be affected. Those who are bullish on BTC should take this regulatory risk into greater consideration. If the court ultimately sides with Arkansas, that would be negative for sentiment among mining companies worldwide.

This assessment would no longer apply if major economies around the world begin imposing strict restrictions on foreign investment in the digital economy.

📰 刚说 Arkansas 矿法被阻，现在法院却把案件拖到年底：为什么数字基建的审批战还要打下去？

阿肯色州想管住外国人在当地挖比特币的权力，法院说“再等等”，这事儿可能定下新规矩：以后各州能不能管数字产业的跨国投资，得看这个判决。这对想搞数字经济的跨国公司、对挖矿的地方经济都有影响。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事根本原因在于：挖矿用钱多、用电多，地方政府想用“本土优先”留住投资，但挖矿公司又想全球招人便宜。阿肯色州这个法，就是想改规则，让本地人先得。法院不直接判对错，而是想等全国其他地方怎么搞，搞明白再定。这意味着各州之间的政策竞争要更激烈了，以后跨国投资数字产业的地方规则可能越来越不一样。

对市场的影响
这条新闻本身不直接砸价格，但暗示了挖矿行业的监管不确定性还在。全球挖矿商本来就在争电价、争地皮，这个判决拖得越久，越没人敢大笔投。如果各州都能随便立法，那跨国挖矿公司就会更谨慎，可能把资金往政策更明确的地方跑。长期看，这对 BTC 的需求是个小压力，因为挖矿是 BTC 需求里最直接的部分之一。但短期内，市场可能因为“政策风险”情绪波动一下。历史上类似事件不多，但可以参考各国对待外资的产业政策演变。

操作思路
💡 这事儿目前看对 BTC/ETH 没有明确的方向，就是增加了数字基建投资的风险溢价。如果未来某州真的严格限制外国挖矿，那 BTC 需求端可能真的受影响。意味着现在看多 BTC 的，要多考虑这个监管风险点。如果法院最终支持阿肯色州，那对全球挖矿商情绪是利空。

如果全球主要经济体都开始严格限制数字经济的外资，这个判断作废。

subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math of Going All-In—After Reading This, Will You Still Dare?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when you’re right and losing 50% when you’re wrong. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in every time, here’s the long-term calculation: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
which looks like a positive expectation. But consider the path: two consecutive losses leave you down 75%, and you’d need to gain 300% to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all-in = a high probability of going bankrupt. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

Take the same strategy, but use only 20% of your capital each time: two consecutive losses mean -18%, hardly a devastating hit,
and you still capture the long-term expected returns. The strategy hasn’t changed—only your position size. The outcome is completely different.

NIP Group was originally focused on esports, but is now transitioning into digital infrastructure, with Bitcoin mining becoming a key area of investment.

Why does this news matter?
NIP Group is a publicly listed company, which means its increased investment in mining isn’t just a personal hobby—it’s a serious business decision. This reflects a new trend in the Bitcoin mining industry: companies from traditional sectors are starting to view computing power as a valuable asset, recognizing its potential to generate a steady stream of Bitcoin revenue.

NIP Group is based in Abu Dhabi, which is a particularly interesting location. The Middle East has taken a mixed approach to cryptocurrency lately: some jurisdictions have imposed strict regulations, while others are actively trying to attract crypto businesses. NIP Group’s increased investment may reflect its belief in the region’s potential demand for the digital economy, or the cost advantages of operating there.

Market impact
A major player like NIP Group adding more computing power can lift market sentiment. After all, more computing power means a more secure network, which usually gives Bitcoin bulls greater confidence.

Historically, Bitcoin’s price has often risen in the short term whenever a well-known company has announced a major investment in mining. For example, after Bitfinex announced plans to build a mining facility in 2022, BTC quickly climbed from $16K to $19K. As a publicly listed company, NIP Group’s move deserves more attention than an investment by an ordinary miner.

Trading outlook
NIP Group’s move suggests that, at least in the eyes of this esports company, investing in Bitcoin computing power has long-term value. This means that in the short term, Bitcoin may find support from miners’ continued investment. Just now, a report put the UK’s crypto-funding difficulties in the spotlight: over 90 days, banks received more than 10,000 complaints about “money transfers to crypto platforms being blocked” 🇬🇧

Crypto advocacy group Stand With Crypto found that between May and August this year, 9,803 people filed 10,092 complaints with UK banks, all concerning blocked transfers to compliant platforms registered with the FCA (the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority).

A few details that are easy to overlook 👇
🔹 Lloyds Banking Group received the most complaints, with 2,297, followed by Barclays with 1,569, NatWest Group with 1,278, and HSBC UK with over 1,000
🔹 Barclays and HSBC: a maximum of £2,500 per transaction and £10,000 in total over 30 days
🔹 NatWest: a maximum of £1,000 per day and £5,000 over 30 days; Santander: £1,000 per transaction and £3,000 per month
🔹 Six banks, including Starling, TSB, and Chase UK, don’t allow transfers to crypto platforms at all
🔹 Lloyds and Revolut haven’t announced any restrictions, but users still report being unable to make transfers; complaints came from all 650 UK parliamentary constituencies

What’s more awkward is that the UK plans to require crypto firms to obtain FCA authorisation from October 2027, but bank account opening isn’t covered by this framework. Even with all the necessary licences, a platform may still be unable to open a UK business bank account.

On one hand, JPMorgan has ranked Bitcoin first in its 10-year return forecasts; on the other, major UK banks are putting up barrier after barrier at the funding stage. Traditional banks are still far from united in their attitude towards crypto.

Put simply: if you’re funding a crypto account in the UK, check your bank’s per-transaction and monthly limits first. Split large transfers into smaller amounts and keep records—don’t wait until your money gets stuck in transit to panic.

刚刚，一份报告把英国银行的「入金难」摆上了台面：90 天里，银行收到了 1 万多条“钱转不到币圈平台”的投诉🇬🇧

加密倡导组织 Stand With Crypto 统计：今年 5 月到 8 月，9803 人向英国银行提交了 10092 条投诉，而且全部是往 FCA（英国金融行为监管局）注册的合规平台转账时受阻。

几个容易被忽略的细节👇
🔹 投诉最多的是劳埃德银行集团 2297 条，巴克莱 1569 条，NatWest 集团 1278 条，汇丰英国也超过 1000 条
🔹 巴克莱、汇丰：单笔最多 2500 英镑，30 天累计最多 1 万英镑
🔹 NatWest：每天最多 1000 英镑、30 天最多 5000 英镑；桑坦德单笔 1000 英镑、每月 3000 英镑
🔹 Starling、TSB、Chase UK 等 6 家银行，直接不让往加密平台转账
🔹 劳埃德和 Revolut 没公布任何限制，但用户照样反映转不过去；投诉覆盖了英国全部 650 个议会选区

更尴尬的是：英国计划 2027 年 10 月起要求加密企业必须拿到 FCA 授权，可银行开户并不在这套框架里，平台拿齐了牌照，也未必开得了英国的企业账户。

一边是摩根大通把比特币排进十年回报预测的第一名，一边是英国大银行在入金口层层设卡，传统银行对加密的态度还远没统一。

说白了：在英国入金，先查清自己银行的单笔和月度限额，大额分批、保留记录，别等钱卡在路上才着急。

截至二零二六年十月二十日，以太坊现货报价二千四百三十三美元，过去二十四小时上涨百分之一点八五。价格从二千三百八十四美元的低点强势反弹至二千四百七十二美元的高位后出现回调，整体呈现先扬后抑的走势特征。从小时线级别观察，以太坊在触及布林带上轨二千四百六十四美元附近后遭遇阻力，随后回踩至二千四百三十美元一线。当前价格运行在七日均线二千四百四十七美元下方，但依然位于二十五日均线二千四百一十三美元和九十九日均线二千四百一十二美元之上，均线系统呈现多头排列但短期均线有走平迹象。值得注意的是，以太坊当前价格与九十九日均线非常接近，显示中长期支撑位正在接受考验。

二、技术指标解读

从技术指标来看，以太坊同样面临多空博弈的关键时刻。MACD指标方面，DIF线为十点四九，DEA线为六点四二，柱状图为四点零七，MACD维持正值但柱状图持续收窄，多头动能逐步减弱。RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为五十七点八一，十二周期RSI为五十八点二五，二十四周期RSI为五十五点七五，三线均处于五十上方的中性偏强区域，但较前期高点明显回落，显示短期超买压力已得到释放。KDJ指标显示K线为六十二点四四，D线为六十三点七六，J线为五十九点八一，三线从高位回落并趋于粘合，暗示短期可能进入震荡整理阶段。布林带指标显示上轨为二千四百六十七美元，中轨为二千四百一十五美元，下轨为二千三百六十二美元，价格在中轨上方运行，带宽有所收窄。ATR真实波动幅度为十九点二八，较前期下降，市场波动率趋于收敛。抛物线SAR指标显示当前SAR值为二千四百零一美元，位于价格下方，维持看多信号。

⑥ 恐慌期：连续暴跌，割肉声一片——而下一轮的种子就埋在这里。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone says it’s just a bounce before another sell-off.
② Acceptance: Prices hit a new high, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors board hesitantly.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy pullback—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge again and again, and everyone rushes to sell at a loss—yet this is where the seeds of the next cycle are sown.

BTC funds attract inflows while ETH funds see outflows | Capital preference hasn’t spread in sync | I’m not chasing ETH for now

Let me make my position clear first: signs of capital flowing back into the broader market don’t mean ETH is getting the same support right away. The topic trending on Binance Square, #USBitcoinETFsRecord$527MInflows, checks out against Farside’s fund-by-fund flows: on October 19, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw a combined net inflow of $526.7 million. On the same trading day, U.S. Ethereum ETFs saw a combined net outflow of $103.3 million, including about $95.4 million from ETHA, $6 million from FETH, and $1.9 million from ETHE. This is a comparison across products for a date with reported data. It doesn’t mean capital is necessarily “moving from ETH to BTC,” nor does it prove that all holders are selling spot ETH. Investors, creation and redemption activity, and trading motives may differ between the two product types.

Why should traders pay attention? If flows into BTC improve first while ETH funds continue to bleed, the market could show a pattern of “support for the broader market, but relative underperformance by Ethereum.” ETH is also affected by other factors, such as staking, on-chain activity, and upgrade expectations, so it shouldn’t be priced based on a BTC flow chart alone. The Ethereum Foundation’s recently announced Glamsterdam plan still points to an October 26 activation on the Hoodi testnet, with the mainnet date yet to be determined. The testnet schedule is genuine official progress, but it is not evidence of net inflows into ETH ETFs, nor does it mean the mainnet has been upgraded. Farside’s individual fund entries for October 20 are still incomplete for both types of funds; the trailing 0.0 simply means the data is not yet complete and should not be described as “zero” or a “reversal” for that day.

How is the market reacting? At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $2,434.3 on Kraken, with a 24-hour range of $2,370.41–$2,475; BTC was around $82,321 over the same period, still below its 24-hour high near $83,339. ETH hasn’t automatically broken above $2,475 just because BTC funds saw inflows, which shows that independent confirmation is needed. My key levels are the $2,475 upper bound, the opening reference around $2,405, and the range low at $2,370. If ETH moves above $2,475 and holds on a retest, then there would be reason to discuss a catch-up rally. If it spikes and then falls back below $2,405, the short-term view that inflows are spreading would be weakened. If it breaks below $2,370 and fails to reclaim it on a bounce, I’ll abandon the bullish outlook. Price and flow data are conditions to watch, not guaranteed outcomes.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t chase ETH higher at this point; I’d only consider a small spot position in the direction of the trend. I’d need to see ETH hold firmly above $2,475, withstand a retest, and see the next complete set of fund data no longer showing significant deterioration before I’d try a long with 2% of my total capital. The first target would be $2,500, where I’d take half off, and I’d watch $2,550 with the remainder. If price fell back below $2,405 after entry, I’d stop out and close the entire position. If $2,475 remains unbroken, I’ll stay out of the market rather than write “waiting for a catch-up rally” as though I’ve already bought. If BTC weakens, ETF data is revised, or macro risks rise, I’ll exit early. The more important thing today is to distinguish BTC’s inflow momentum from ETH’s own confirmation signals, rather than treating the two coins as one trade.

Sources: Farside’s fund-by-fund BTC and ETH ETF flow tables, the Ethereum Foundation’s Hoodi announcement, and Kraken’s public market snapshot. #USBitcoinETFsRecord$527MInflows #BTC #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

BTC基金吸金而ETH基金流出｜资金偏好并未同步扩散｜我暂不追ETH

态度先讲清楚：大盘出现资金回流的迹象，不代表ETH立即得到同样支持。币安广场热议的#USBitcoinETFsRecord$527MInflows，核对Farside逐只流量后，10月19日美国现货比特币ETF合计净流入5.267亿美元；同一交易日的美国以太坊ETF合计却净流出1.033亿美元，其中ETHA约流出9540万美元、FETH约流出600万美元、ETHE约流出190万美元。这是已披露日期的跨产品对比，不是说资金一定“从ETH搬到BTC”，更不能据此推断所有持有人都在卖现货ETH。两类产品的投资者、创建赎回和交易动机可能不同。

为什么值得交易者留意？如果BTC资金面先改善，而ETH基金持续失血，市场可能呈现“大盘有支撑、以太坊相对落后”的结构。ETH还受质押、链上活动、升级预期等不同因素影响，不能用BTC一张资金表替它定价。以太坊基金会近期公布的Glamsterdam计划，仍指向10月26日Hoodi测试网激活，主网日期待定；测试网安排是真实官方进展，但不是ETH ETF出现净流入的证据，也不是主网已升级。当前Farside的10月20日两类基金逐只栏位都未填全，尾部0.0只是未有完整数据，不能写成当日“归零”或“扭转”。

市场怎么反应？写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2434.3美元，24小时区间2370.41—2475美元；BTC同期约82321美元，仍在其83339附近的24小时高点下方。ETH并没有因BTC基金流入就自动突破2475，说明需要独立确认。我的关键位是2475的上沿、2405附近的开盘参考以及2370的区间低点。若ETH站上2475后能回踩守住，才有理由讨论补涨；如果冲高又跌回2405之下，资金扩散的短线判断就被削弱；若跌破2370并反抽不过，我会放弃多头设想。价格和流量都只是观察条件，不是结果保证。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与ETH追高，只考虑现货顺势小仓。必须看到ETH有效站稳2475、回踩不破，同时下一份完整基金数据不再显示明显恶化，我才拿总资金的2%试多。第一目标2500，触及减半，余仓观察2550；若入场后跌回2405下方则止损并全部平仓。若2475始终未突破，继续空仓，不把“等待补涨”写成已经买入。若BTC自身转弱、ETF数据被修订或宏观风险上升，我会提前退出。今日更重要的是分清BTC资金热度和ETH自己的确认信号，而不是把两个币混成同一笔交易。

来源：Farside BTC与ETH ETF逐只流量表、以太坊基金会Hoodi公告、Kraken公开行情快照。#USBitcoinETFsRecord$527MInflows #BTC #ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。
